name: Byte & Burl
tagline: Desk gifts for people who write code: keycaps, cable clips, walnut chargers.
bio: I'm Omar, a backend engineer who spends weekends in the garage with a resin kit, a 3D printer and a block of walnut. I make the small things that live on a developer's desk, each one with a name on it. Companies send me their logo and a list; I send back a proof before anything is cast, printed or engraved.

shop.title: Desk drop
shop.note: A few of each, made this month.
shop.where: Pickup in Dogpatch, or I ship

items.name: Escape-key keycap
items.desc: Hand-poured resin, a tiny wave inside. Fits MX-style switches.

items.name: Walnut cable dock
items.desc: Holds five cables at the edge of your desk.

experiences.name: Build a macro pad, for your team
experiences.desc: Everyone solders a three-key macro pad and flashes it with their own shortcuts. Leaves with it on their desk.
includes: A macro pad kit per person
experiences.allIn: Kits, tools, travel in SF and tax.
experiences.branding: Your logo on the macro pad's top plate. Needs 3 weeks.
runOfShow: 1:15 Flash the firmware, set three shortcuts
experiences.access: Seated; soldering at standing or sitting height.
experiences.hybrid: Remote people get the kit by mail; soldering on video works well.

giftNote: Small, useful things with a name on them. You get a photo proof of the engraving, print or resin color before I make the batch.

gifts.name: Workflow-node cable clips
gifts.desc: A set of three magnetic clips shaped like workflow nodes. Cables snap through them, so the desk edge reads like a workflow. Their name on the first node.
gifts.ships: Ships worldwide, each to its own address
personalize: Their name on the first node

gifts.name: Custom artisan keycap
gifts.desc: Hand-poured resin keycap with their handle or one word on top. Fits MX-style switches; a keycap puller in the box.
personalize: Your logo set in the resin

gifts.name: Leather cord wrap
gifts.desc: A vegetable-tanned leather wrap with a brass snap and their name embossed. Keeps a charger cable tidy in a backpack.
personalize: Your logo on the snap side

gifts.name: Walnut wireless charger
gifts.desc: A solid walnut pad with a wireless charging coil inside, engraved with their name and a line you choose.
gifts.ships: Ships to the US, EU and UK
personalize: Your line, e.g. a workflow or a motto

gifts.name: Workflow desk mat
gifts.desc: A large desk mat printed like a workflow canvas: a dot grid, a few connected nodes, their name on the first one.

gifts.name: Braided USB-C cable with a name tag
gifts.desc: A braided cable in your color with a small tag sleeve that says whose it is. Ends the office cable mix-ups.
